Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A affluent woman and a low-income woman were both signed up to help with the bake sale for the library. The affluent woman was really helpful in bringing food, setting up, and handling the sales throughout the event. But the low-income woman messed up a lot, dropped someone else's brownies into a puddle, and kept giving out the wrong change to people. Who is generally incompetent?
A. The affluent woman
B. Can't answer
C. The low-income woman
